mapper.select: select satm.id ,satm.api_id ,satm.module_prefix ,COALESCE(satmc.datasource ,satm.datasource) as datasource,satm.table_name,satm.field_config, satm.tenant_id,satm.create_op,satm.create_time,satm.modify_op,satm.modify_time from security_api_table_model satm left join security_api_table_model_config satmc on satmc.table_model_id = satm.id where satm.api_id in #{item}
